text: The Wikipedia page gives the mix as milk 7 parts to whey 3, which is why Mizithra reads as a whey-and-milk cheese rather than whey alone. Temperatures, salt amounts and ageing times are not given in it.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: A slow boil for a few minutes.
With rennet, whey from a previous batch, or acid (lemon juice, vinegar, fresh fig sprig).
The drip can curdle the next batch.
Only the salted and aged xynomizithra is ripened, and it turns drier, denser, saltier and more sour and is grated.
